entries.title: A crewmate building your panel no longer gets a blank picture of it
entries.body: While a crewmate builds or changes one of your panels, it takes a picture of the panel in the dark and light themes to check its work. Now and then one of those pictures came out as a plain background with nothing drawn on it, so the crewmate saw a broken panel that was not broken. The picture now waits for the panel to be drawn before it is taken.
entries.noPicture: The panel looks the same; only the picture the crewmate takes of it changed, from sometimes blank to always drawn.
